text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I, the Overlord, am determined to be reborn new and true. Just at this critical moment, I detect signs of Poseidon's coming from the sea…

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: But contemptibly, what appears instead is the Golden Generation's Phantom Bird, El Condor Pasa—arisen to educate me in the ways of combat!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I meet the wrestler head-on. And then I see clearly—this is how a ruler does battle! The truly strong do not fear to be a target, no matter how vexing it may be.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Thus, I have now learned how I must fight as the Overlord—no—as the Centurial Overlord!
